grammar_focus: 条件句 if(真实条件:if + 一般现在, will do;与现在相反的虚拟:if + 过去时, would do / if I were you;与过去相反的虚拟:if + had done, would have done),外加 wish / if only + 过去时(与现在相反的愿望)/ 过去完成(对过去的懊悔)(原创承载 NCE3 L12 考点·两人在珊瑚岛意外过了五天惬意的荒岛生活)
scene: 我们大多数人对荒岛生活的想象都很不真实。我们爱把它当成一种乐园:阳光永远灿烂,熟果从树上落下,谁也不必干活。可另一面恰恰相反:孤岛上的日子也可能十分凄惨,一个落难者也许会像鲁滨孙那样慢慢挨饿,苦等一艘永远不来的船。这两幅画面里也许都有一点真实成分,可我们很少有人有机会亲身去验证。最近有两个朋友在一座小珊瑚岛上待了五天,却真希望当时能待得更久。他们本是驾着一条严重受损的小船,从维尔京群岛开往迈阿密去修理,途中船开始进水下沉。他们手脚麻利地往一条橡皮小艇里装了食物、火柴和几罐汽水,划了好几英里,横渡加勒比海,来到一座小珊瑚岛。岛上几乎没有树,也没有淡水,可这并没成为问题:他们用橡皮艇接雨水。因为带了一把捕鱼枪,他们吃得很足——天天捕龙虾和鱼,用其中一人的话说,他们“吃得像国王”。五天后一艘过路油轮救了他们,两人都由衷地舍不得离开。要不是那艘油轮恰好路过,谁知道他们还会再待多久呢!

grammar_card.title: 条件句 if + 虚拟愿望 wish / if only
grammar_card.intro: ①真实条件:很可能发生,if 从句用一般现在时,主句用将来时——If it rains, we will stay。②与现在事实相反的虚拟:if 从句用过去时,主句 would do;be 动词一律用 were——If I were you, I would go。③与过去事实相反的虚拟:if 从句用过去完成,主句 would have done——If they had not brought a gun, they would have starved。④表示愿望用 wish 或 if only:对现在的愿望用过去时(I wish I knew…),对过去的懊悔用过去完成(They wished they had stayed longer / If only I had known!)。

rows: If it rains, we will stay home.
If I were you, I would go.
If they had come, they would have seen it.
过去时(现在)/ 过去完成(过去)
I wish I knew. / They wished they had stayed.

specialRules.rule: 虚拟里 be 动词一律用 were,不分人称:If I were you… / I wish he were here。
wish/if only 后:想改变现在的状况用过去时(I wish I had a boat 现在没有),后悔过去的事用过去完成(I wish I hadn't said that 过去说了)。
美语里“汽水”常说 soda(英式 fizzy drink);“(易拉)罐”说 can(英式 tin)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What was exceptional about the two men's stay on the island?
options: They enjoyed it and were sorry to leave

passage: Most of us have a very unrealistic picture of life on a desert island. We like to imagine it as a kind of paradise, where the sun always shines, ripe fruit drops from the trees, and no one ever has to work. The other side of the picture is quite the opposite: life on a lonely island can be wretched, and a castaway may slowly starve, like Robinson Crusoe, waiting for a boat that never comes. There is probably an element of truth in both pictures, but few of us ever get the opportunity to find out. Two friends who recently spent five days on a tiny coral island wished they had stayed even longer. They had been sailing a badly damaged boat from the Virgin Islands to Miami to have it repaired when, halfway across, it began to sink. Working fast, they loaded a small rubber dinghy with food, matches, and cans of soda, and rowed for miles across the Caribbean until they reached a coral island. There were almost no trees and no fresh water, but that did not turn out to be a problem: the men caught rainwater in the dinghy. Because they had packed a spear gun, they had plenty to eat. Every day they caught lobster and fish, and, as one of them said, they 'ate like kings.' When a passing tanker rescued them five days later, both men were genuinely sorry to leave. If that tanker had not come along, who knows how much longer they would have stayed!

grammar_points.name: 真实条件句(if + 一般现在, will do)
与现在相反的虚拟条件(if + 过去时, would do)
与过去相反的虚拟条件(if + had done, would have done)
wish + 过去时(与现在相反的愿望)
wish/if only + 过去完成(对过去的懊悔)

stage5.stem: "If it rains tomorrow, we ___ the boat trip."(真实条件:if 一般现在,主句将来时)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果明天下雨,我们就取消坐船的行程。

stage5.stem: "You ___ hungry if you don't catch any fish."(真实条件:主句将来时)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果你钓不到鱼,就会饿。

stage5.stem: "If I ___ you, I would stay on that island longer."(与现在相反的虚拟:be 用哪个)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果我是你,我会在那岛上多待些时候。

stage5.stem: "If they ___ a spear gun now, they could catch fish easily."(与现在相反:if 从句用过去时)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果他们现在有一把鱼枪,就能轻松捕鱼。

stage5.stem: "If the island ___ fresh water, life there would be easier."(与现在相反的虚拟)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果岛上有淡水,生活会容易些。

stage5.stem: "If the boat had not started to sink, they ___ on it."(与过去相反:主句 would have + 过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 要是船没开始下沉,他们本会留在船上。

stage5.stem: "If that tanker ___ come along, they might have stayed for weeks."(与过去相反:if 从句用过去完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 要是那艘油轮没恰好路过,他们可能还得待上几周。

stage5.stem: "They ___ if they had not brought the spear gun."(与过去相反:主句 might have + 过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 要是他们没带鱼枪,可能就挨饿了。

stage5.stem: "I wish I ___ how to fish like those two men."(与现在相反的愿望:wish + 过去时)
stage5.stem_cn: 我真希望自己像那两人一样会捕鱼。

stage5.stem: "The castaways wish the island ___ more trees for shade."(与现在相反的愿望:wish + 过去时)
stage5.stem_cn: 落难者们真希望岛上多些树好遮阴。

stage5.stem: "I wish I ___ a boat right now to sail away."(与现在相反的愿望:wish + 过去时)
stage5.stem_cn: 我真希望现在有条船可以开走。

stage5.stem: "The two men wished they ___ longer on the island."(对过去的愿望:wish + 过去完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 那两人真希望当时在岛上多待些时候。

stage5.stem: "If only they ___ more matches before the boat sank!"(对过去的懊悔:if only + 过去完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 要是船沉之前他们多带些火柴就好了!

stage5.stem: "I wish I ___ so much money on that trip."(对过去的懊悔:wish + hadn't done)
stage5.stem_cn: 我真后悔那趟旅行花了那么多钱。

stage5.stem: "A small island built up by tiny sea creatures is a ___ island."(“珊瑚”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 由微小海洋生物堆积成的小岛是珊瑚岛。

stage5.stem: "A person left alone on a lonely island is a ___."(“漂流者、落难者”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 被独自留在孤岛上的人是落难者。

stage5.stem: "A big ship that carries oil is a ___."(“油轮”用哪个词)
"To suffer or die from lack of food is to ___."(“挨饿”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 因缺食物而受苦或饿死就是 starve。

stage7_cloze.context: Two men wished they ___1___ longer on the desert island. If they ___2___ brought a spear gun, they would have gone hungry. Luckily, they had one, so they ate well. 'I wish every trip ___3___ this much fun,' one of them joked. If only the rescue ship ___4___ come a little later!

stage8_listening.stem: How did the two men reach the coral island?

stage8_listening.stem: How did the men feel when they were rescued?

options: I wish I knew how to fish like them.
I wish I know how to fish like them.
I wish I will know how to fish like them.
I wish I have known how to fish like them.

stage9_scenario.stem: 你想说"他们真希望当时在岛上多待些时候"(wish + 过去完成,对过去):
options: They wished they had stayed longer on the island.
They wished they stayed longer on the island.

options: If they had not brought a spear gun, they would have starved.
If they did not bring a spear gun, they would starve.

If they not brought a spear gun, they would have starved.

stage10.stem: "If I ___ you, I would stay on the island longer."(与现在相反:if I ___ you)
stage10.stem_cn: 如果我是你,我会在岛上多待些时候。

stage10.stem: "The men wished they ___ longer on the island."(对过去的愿望:wish + 过去完成)
